report:
Reviewed the complete numeric_domains claim and all five ordinary implementation associations, twelve ordinary test entries, and the existing semantic_spec TODO. Requirements are equality-class-wide effective domains, monotone intersection, transaction commit/rollback and revision/wake behavior, concrete numeric types only from semantic constraints, no narrowing from overloadable token spelling, and no numeric default at quiescence.

Implementation: unify.rs resolves representatives before compatible_domain, intersects unresolved domains or checks rigid membership, and wraps structural relations and exact bounds in child probes. Success rebuilds/collapses; any error discards the child. egraph.rs effective_domain follows find through the full equality chain, reads the nearest ancestral refinement, and returns no unresolved domain for a concrete representative. set_domain_in asserts narrowing, skips identical refinements, and records semantic changes/wakes. collapse_into merges domains/revisions/wakes only for an exclusive leaf; discard clears child state. version.rs implements Any as the intersection identity and disjoint Integer/Float families; admits accepts signed/unsigned integer primitives or float primitives respectively, with explicit error recovery. infer_ctx.rs publishes committed wakes to obligations/runtime, applies semantic proof results, and finalizes unresolved domains with domain-specific diagnostics and Ty::Error. Its quiescence fallback handles only previously deferred never targets; it does not choose i32/f64. operator.rs instantiates trait signatures from operand types and submits trait/projection obligations; its token mapping selects a method, not a numeric family. Signature-validation probes are discarded. expr.rs captured dispatch forwards binary operators and preserves the unary operand type. These essential implementation files now have explicit associations, so their changes invalidate this review.

Tests inspected: variable_union_intersects_domains_in_both_orders asserts Integer for both members regardless of union orientation and a committed wake. incompatible_transitive_domain_union_rolls_back proves Any previously joined with Integer rejects Float and preserves both roots, the class restriction, and revision. domain_narrowing_follows_child_commit_and_discard verifies child-only narrowing, unchanged parent after discard, committed refinement and wake. numeric_domains_accept_members_and_reject_other_families asserts accepted signed/unsigned/float bindings and rejected cross-family bindings with unchanged roots/revisions. exact_bounds_enforce_domains_transactionally checks rejected exact bounds preserve Bound::None, domain, revision; exact_bounds_join_the_validated_equality_class checks exact-bound aliasing propagates restrictions and rejects incompatible later bindings in either resolved/unresolved scenario. reported_error_recovery_is_admitted_by_numeric_domains asserts explicit reported errors resolve both numeric families, without defaulting.

All five source tests have visible fixture/expectation assertions: return_context_constrains_numeric_literals_through_generic_calls checks u16 and f32 propagation through id; later_numeric_constraint_selects_an_impl_through_a_where_clause checks a later integer constraint selects Maybe<u8> over Maybe<bool>; distinct_numeric_classes_take_independent_contextual_types observes u8/u64/f32/f64 independently; numeric_domains_reject_nonmembers expects errors for integer-as-bool, integer-as-float, and float-as-integer; unconstrained_numeric_literals_report_errors_instead_of_defaulting expects both numeric inference diagnostics and <error> observations, with the intentional Sage/rustc difference visible in the fixture.

Deferred evidence: sage_meta::todo::inference_numeric_domains explicitly calls for completion of the verification matrix. Preserve this TODO: it is not a passing behavioral test. Existing ordinary evidence establishes many listed cases, but comprehensive operator-preproof Any preservation and combined source-level/revision/wake matrix scenarios remain deferred. Retirement requires substantive assertions observing those intermediate states and completing the enumerated matrix; this review does not claim that deferred coverage exists. There are no N/A entries and no production behavior classified TODO. The implementation inspection found no behavioral violation requiring a regression investigation.

Executed cargo fmt, cargo build (passed, existing warnings), cargo test -p sage-ir check::infer::unify::tests --lib (19 passed, including rerun after association attributes), and cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test inference numeric -- --nocapture (5 passed). These results are separate from the source adequacy assessment. Changes consist only of implementation/test associations; centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks remain coordinator obligations. No further anchor edits requested; existing explicit verification deferral remains visible.
